newsitem.title: HUNGARY: FOREIGNERS RETURN TO HUNGARY FX MKT AFTER PEG CHANGE.
newsitem.headline: FOREIGNERS RETURN TO HUNGARY FX MKT AFTER PEG CHANGE.

text.p: The Hungarian forint closed little changed against the dollar on Tuesday amidst renewed foreign interest in the market following goverment plans to reduce the forint's crawling inflation, dealers said.
The forint stood at 176.98/177.03 at the close, compared to a noon level of 177.01/06 and an opening of 176.75/80.

"It was an average day's turnover but there was evidence that the government's weekend decision to reduce the crawling peg devaluator to 1.1 pct on April 1 has rekindled foreign interest in the market," said Istvan Gere of ING Bank.
The buying interest in the forint was keeping the unit at the top end of the intervention band at five to 10 pips from the resistance level, Gere added.
